title: Beyond the Parameter Monolith: Reconstructive Memories, Executable Skills, and Residual Assembly for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.04012v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Can a language-model system grow its external state and use executable procedures without making every component part of one shared optimization process? We present FEM-ASM, an implemented architecture that separates neural coordination, document-state construction, and deterministic execution. Independent workers optimize document memories under a frozen codec and publish immutable, versioned artifacts. Executable skills return bounded computation results. Both enter a shared neural field through type-specific adapters, explicit support mappings, and a common residual-assembly operator. The resulting computation couples a quadratic consistency substep to a recurrent learned correction. We evaluate memory construction, controlled retrieval, positional readout, execution-result rendering, and evidence attachment with unchanged core weights. The experiments show that recoverable storage, successful retrieval, and successful neural use

translated_title: 超越参数巨石：面向语言模型的重构性记忆、可执行技能与残差组装
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.04012v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：一个语言模型系统能否在不把每个组件都纳入同一个共享优化过程的情况下，扩展其外部状态并使用可执行程序？我们提出了 FEM-ASM，一个已实现的架构，它将神经协调、文档状态构建和确定性执行相互分离。独立的工作器在冻结的编解码器下优化文档记忆，并发布不可变的、带版本号的制品。可执行技能返回有界的计算结果。两者通过类型特定的适配器、显式支持映射以及一个共同的残差组装算子进入共享的神经场。由此得到的计算将二次一致性子步骤与循环的学习校正耦合在一起。我们在核心权重保持不变的前提下，评估了记忆构建、受控检索、位置读出、执行结果渲染以及证据附加。实验表明，可恢复的存储、成功的检索以及成功的神经使用……
tldr: 该论文提出 FEM-ASM 架构，将神经协调、文档状态构建与确定性执行解耦，使语言模型能够在核心权重保持不变的情况下，通过外部重构性记忆和可执行技能来扩展能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes FEM-ASM, an architecture that decouples neural coordination, document-state construction, and deterministic execution, enabling language models to extend their capabilities via external reconstructive memories and executable skills while keeping core weights unchanged.
